categories.name: TPE Power Cords
categories.notes: TPE insulated, TPR black jacket. W suffix: white jacket.

categories.name: PVC Power Cords
categories.notes: PVC insulated, PVC black jacket. Numbers ending in W are the same cord in white.

categories.name: TPE Power Cords (TPE Jacket)
categories.notes: TPE throughout, insulation and jacket. E suffix series.

categories.name: Communications & Electronic Control Cords
categories.notes: Number ending in 5P = PVC jacket, 7P = Auta-Prene TPE jacket. Colors on request.

categories.name: Auta-Prene Test Leads
categories.notes: Single-conductor 5000V test leads. Stocked in 12 and 24 inch retracted lengths.

categories.name: PVC or Auta-Prene Shielded Cords
categories.notes: Each conductor individually served shielded with 36 AWG soft tinned copper, average 90% coverage. Conductors white and/or black. Capacitance values on request.

categories.name: PVC Shielded Cords
categories.notes: Overall served shield, 36 AWG soft tinned copper, average 90% coverage. Black jacket, colors on request. Capacitance values on request.

categories.name: PVC Miniature Cords
categories.notes: 28 AWG miniature cords, black jacket. Colors on request.

categories.name: PVC Miniature Cords with Foil Shield
categories.notes: Overall foil shield, black jacket. Colors on request. Capacitance values on request.
